source_priority.R1: For executable model configuration, the official released inference / reproduction code or released config (level 2-3) takes precedence over prose in the paper (level 1) when they conflict, unless the protocol specifies otherwise. Protocol rules (§3, §4.2) always take precedence over model documentation.
source_priority.R2: No alternative is ever chosen by DS203 output quality, real-frame throughput or any causal result.

common.preprocessing: §3.1 standardized acquisition (centre square crop, bilinear antialiased resize to the input size, circular mask r x side (r = 0.45 unless the §14-4a mechanical check changes it) and 3 % bottom band set to 0); native arm (FM-P-nat, primary model only, §3.2): resize of the full frame to the input size, no crop, no mask
common.inference: model.eval() + torch.inference_mode(); bf16 on CUDA (§4.1.4 rule 4 'bf16 where supported')
common.storage: per case (n_steps, D) float32 (pipeline.extract_all); PCA to 64 PCs and LEACE per fold (§4.2-4.3)

checkpoint.note: README 'Teacher Backbone' column (also the README loading example); the 'Full DINO checkpoint' file is not the backbone

SurgeNetCholec.temporal_sampling: frame-level: every frame of the 2-fps physical-time grid (§3.1 step 1); the step representation is the mean of the step's ten frame embeddings 10t..10t+9 (§4.2)
SurgeNetCholec.representation_tensor: timm caformer_s18 forward_features -> forward_head(pre_logits=True): LayerNorm of the stage-4 feature map averaged over H, W (= SurgeNet metaformer.py `self.norm(x.mean([1, 2]))`)
SurgeNetCholec.pooling: global average over the stage-4 spatial grid (7 x 7 at 224); then the ten-frame step mean
SurgeNetCholec.stochastic_layers: none active: eval() disables drop-path / dropout
SurgeNetCholec.config_overrides_paper: input 224 x 224 and ImageNet normalisation: no level-1-3 SurgeNet source states the pretraining input size or normalisation (224 x 399 bicubic is the downstream fine-tuning input); 224 = CAFormer-S18 / ImageNet-1k initialisation resolution and timm pretrained_cfg (judgement call, frozen)

VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.temporal_sampling: clip-level: one clip per step = the 16 most recent 2-fps grid frames ending at grid frame 10t+9 (no frame after 5t+5); at the video start the first grid frame is repeated (§4.2). Rationale (protocol §4.2 [v0.4-final2]): the 2-fps grid standardizes acquisition across centres at the cost of temporal fidelity; the model's documented clip length is kept, its documented frame rate is not
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.normalisation: RGB frames / 255, then per channel (x - mean) / std with mean (0.485, 0.456, 0.406), std (0.229, 0.224, 0.225): the values DataAugmentationForVideoMAE applies to every pre-training input (datasets.py @ 14ef8d85: 'self.input_mean = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]  # IMAGENET_DEFAULT_MEAN', 'self.input_std = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]  # IMAGENET_DEFAULT_STD', GroupNormalize after Stack(roll=False) and ToTorchFormatTensor(div=True); transforms.py semantics); the same transform for every pre-training dataset (build_pretraining_dataset), hence all nine checkpoints
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.representation_tensor: encoder forward_features with no token masked = final LayerNorm (encoder norm, eps 1e-6) of the last block's output; implemented as transformers VideoMAEModel configured from pretrain_videomae_small_patch16_224 (equivalence with the original encoder code checked on random weights)
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.pooling: mean over all 1568 patch tokens (8 temporal x 14 x 14 spatial; tubelet 2, patch 16); no CLS token exists
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.stochastic_layers: no token masking at inference; drop / drop-path rates 0; eval()
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.config_overrides_paper: architecture from the official pre-training model definition (rule R1); LayerNorm eps 1e-6 per the official code (the HF alias configs use 1e-12)
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.class_line: VideoMAE eligibility applies to official pre-training checkpoints of the masked-autoencoder model; supervised fine-tuned classification/action-recognition checkpoints are outside the secondary reconstructive/generative class.
VideoMAE:k400-vit-s-1600.normalisation_note: modeling_finetune.py::_cfg() reports mean/std 0.5 as model default_cfg metadata, but the pre-training data pipeline is the source that trained the pre-training checkpoints, and it governs under the source-priority rule. Fine-tuned checkpoints remain outside the secondary class.

checkpoint.format: original (official pre-training checkpoint; state dict mapped with transformers' convert_videomae_to_pytorch encoder rules)

VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.temporal_sampling: clip-level: one clip per step = the 16 most recent 2-fps grid frames ending at grid frame 10t+9 (no frame after 5t+5); at the video start the first grid frame is repeated (§4.2). Rationale (protocol §4.2 [v0.4-final2]): the 2-fps grid standardizes acquisition across centres at the cost of temporal fidelity; the model's documented clip length is kept, its documented frame rate is not
VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.normalisation: RGB frames / 255, then per channel (x - mean) / std with mean (0.485, 0.456, 0.406), std (0.229, 0.224, 0.225): the values DataAugmentationForVideoMAE applies to every pre-training input (datasets.py @ 14ef8d85: 'self.input_mean = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]  # IMAGENET_DEFAULT_MEAN', 'self.input_std = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]  # IMAGENET_DEFAULT_STD', GroupNormalize after Stack(roll=False) and ToTorchFormatTensor(div=True); transforms.py semantics); the same transform for every pre-training dataset (build_pretraining_dataset), hence all nine checkpoints
VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.representation_tensor: encoder forward_features with no token masked = final LayerNorm (encoder norm, eps 1e-6) of the last block's output; implemented as transformers VideoMAEModel configured from pretrain_videomae_base_patch16_224 (equivalence with the original encoder code checked on random weights)
VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.pooling: mean over all 1568 patch tokens (8 temporal x 14 x 14 spatial; tubelet 2, patch 16); no CLS token exists
VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.stochastic_layers: no token masking at inference; drop / drop-path rates 0; eval()
VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.config_overrides_paper: architecture from the official pre-training model definition (rule R1); LayerNorm eps 1e-6 per the official code (the HF alias configs use 1e-12)
VideoMAE:ucf101-vit-b-3200.class_line: VideoMAE eligibility applies to official pre-training checkpoints of the masked-autoencoder model; supervised fine-tuned classification/action-recognition checkpoints are outside the secondary reconstructive/generative class.

OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600.temporal_sampling: clip-level: one clip per step = the 17 most recent 2-fps grid frames ending at grid frame 10t+9 (no frame after 5t+5); at the video start the first grid frame is repeated (§4.2). OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600.normalisation: x/255 - 0.5 -> [-0.5, 0.5], layout (B, 3, T, H, W) (data.py VideoNorm mean 0.5, std 1.0)
OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600.representation_tensor: F.normalize(pre_vq_conv(encoder(x)), dim=1): the l2-normalised 8-d code fed to the codebook lookup (not quantised)
OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600.pooling: mean over latent time (T' = 5 at 17 frames), flattened (c, h, w) = 8 x 32 x 32
OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600.stochastic_layers: none: VQ codebook not applied; attn / ff dropout 0; apply_noise / apply_blur are discriminator (training) options and are not built
OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600.config_overrides_paper: encoder blocks 'ttww' (2 plain + 2 window spatial layers) from the released evaluation script for imagenet_k600.ckpt; the paper says 4 window-attention spatial layers (rule R1)

OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600_vae.temporal_sampling: clip-level: one clip per step = the 17 most recent 2-fps grid frames ending at grid frame 10t+9 (no frame after 5t+5); at the video start the first grid frame is repeated (§4.2). OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600_vae.pooling: mean over latent time (T' = 5 at 17 frames), flattened 8 x 32 x 32
OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600_vae.stochastic_layers: posterior mean (no sampling); attn / ff dropout 0; apply_noise / apply_blur are discriminator (training) options and are not built
OmniTokenizer-imagenet_k600_vae.config_overrides_paper: same eval_video.sh hyperparameters as the VQ checkpoint plus --use_vae (released evaluation script block for imagenet_k600_vae.ckpt); encoder blocks 'ttww' per the script (rule R1)

WF-VAE-L-16ch.temporal_sampling: clip-level: one clip per step = the 33 most recent 2-fps grid frames ending at grid frame 10t+9 (no frame after 5t+5); at the video start the first grid frame is repeated (§4.2). WF-VAE-L-16ch.representation_tensor: WFVAEModel.encode(x).latent_dist.mode() = posterior mean (first 16 channels of encoder.conv_out); scale / shift not applied
WF-VAE-L-16ch.pooling: mean over latent time (T' = 9 at 33 frames), flattened 16 x 32 x 32
WF-VAE-L-16ch.stochastic_layers: posterior mean (no sampling); no quant layer
WF-VAE-L-16ch.config_overrides_paper: clip length 33 = the authors' evaluation / measurement clip (paper: all measurements on 33 frames at 256 x 256; TRAIN_AND_VALIDATE.md NUM_FRAMES=33); training used 25 then 49 frames; the released checkpoint's training stage is not stated (judgement call, frozen; L = 1 + 4k)

LARP-L-Long.temporal_sampling: clip-level: one clip per step = the 16 most recent 2-fps grid frames ending at grid frame 10t+9 (no frame after 5t+5); at the video start the first grid frame is repeated (§4.2). LARP-L-Long.normalisation: x/255 -> [0, 1], no mean / std, layout (B, 3, T, H, W)
LARP-L-Long.representation_tensor: F.normalize(bottleneck.project_in(Z), dim=-1): Z = encoder outputs at the 1024 learned holistic query positions; the l2-normalised 16-d codebook-lookup input (not quantised, not sampled)
LARP-L-Long.pooling: none over time (holistic query tokens have no latent time axis); flattened 1024 x 16
LARP-L-Long.stochastic_layers: the stochastic SVQ (cosine softmax + multinomial sampling) is not applied; dropout 0; eval()
LARP-L-Long.config_overrides_paper: bottleneck_dim 16 from the released config.json; the paper states codebook dimension d' = 8 (rule R1)
